scope: Replace the inherited NGE XP/skill player-level pipeline with Publish 14.1 weapon-skill combat difficulty while preserving named skill XP, authored skill mods, NPC levels, and the separate retained-content encounter score.

findings: Core3 derives the hidden player combat/con difficulty from the readied weapon family's private combat-difficulty skill mod divided by 100 plus one, capped at 25.
Core3 adds private_jedi_difficulty only for a readied lightsaber family.
Publish 14.1 skill grants and surrender operate through skill points, prerequisites, named XP pools, credits, and authored skill mods; they do not create NGE player level XP or level-derived Health.
